title: Micro-economy batch heuristics and sentinel rollout
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Goal: build a recommendation engine (the Micro‑Economy Advisor) that synthesizes workload profiles, cost signals, and latency SLOs to produce per-workload batching and KV caching configs that can be safely applied and rolled back. The engine should: 1) ingest short and long window telemetry (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cache hit ratio, cost per token), 2) generate candidate profiles (microbatch size, max_latency_budget_ms, kv_prefetch_window, prefix_cache_enable), 3) score candidates by expected unit-cost reduction vs SLO risk, and 4) output a staged rollout plan with canary, ramp, and automatic rollback triggers. Emphasize conservative heuristics for latency-sensitive routes and aggressive cost tuning for background or bulk routes.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor produces at least 3 distinct candidate profiles per workload with estimated cost delta and SLO-risk score
Safe-apply pipeline can execute canary (0.5% traffic) -> ramp (5%->25%->100%) with automated rollback on latency or error thresholds
System integrates with Console rollout UI and exposes per-candidate simulation metrics (simulated latency, estimated tokens saved)
End-to-end test using synthetic workload reduces unit cost by >=6% on non-latency sensitive test cohort without SLO violations
Runbook and playbook documented with steps to manually abort/force-rollback and postmortem checklist

2025-02-26 Eng Review: Decided to add safety multiplier reducing batch growth near memory/kv pressure. Added extra KV prewarm step to candidate generation.
2025-03-01 Design feedback from Elena Park: Console rollout UX needs clear action labels and a visible rollback button; added API flag for manual-override.

2025-03-02 Marco Liu: Created draft PR for safe-apply orchestration - https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/8274; smoke tests passing locally; scheduling canary run in staging for 2025-03-05.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: conservative defaults reduce immediate savings but minimize incidents; we prioritize a canary-first rollback cadence. Future work: integrate learned models for candidate generation and add cost-safety SLA knobs per-customer.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Telemetry ingestion and profile extractor (2w)
Phase 2: Heuristic candidate generator and scoring (2w)
Phase 5: Staging canary and rollout, collect post-apply metrics (1w)
